# Stage 4 prompts

Prompts for AI-tutor coaching.

| ID | Title | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [P-S4-01](p-s4-01.md) | One hint from the step-by-step ladder | Give a stuck learner one hint at a time, from a four-level ladder, without revealing the solution outright. |
| [P-S4-02](p-s4-02.md) | Select the next protocol for one interaction | Apply the fixed priority order to one interaction and name which protocol runs next; for an orchestrator session to call, not for a learner to run directly. |
